about_the_game:
Step into the shadowy and dangerous Isle of Gallow as a newly turned vampire, abandoned by your maker. Harrowed World: Portents In Red is an action RPG that lets you Unleash Your Inner Vampire, designing your very own character and forging your own path.

A night of chaos and confusion marks your passage into undeath. When the dust settles, you are tasked with uncovering the meaning behind the mysterious portents in red. Danger is everywhere, and trust is a rare commodity. Choose your allies and enemies well.

Good luck, vampire.

  • Unleash Your Inner Vampire: Craft your character from the ground up. Choose their appearance, style, and customise them to your preferred play style.

  • Dark Dominion: Explore the dark sinister streets of the Isle of Gallow, uncovering secrets, taking on tasks, and delving into the mysteries of vampiric society.

  • Blood Is The Life: Satisfy your need for blood by feeding on the human inhabitants, through stealth, supernatural control, or your unnatural allure.

  • Powers of Darkness: Employ supernatural powers to manipulate, control or harm those around you. Take on the shape of an animal, show your superior vampiric strength, control the minds of mortals, and more.

  • Supernatural Secret: Keep your true nature hidden from the unsuspecting mortals around you, as you tread the thin line between predator and person. Evade government agents and police officers set on neutralising all threats.

  • Immortal Enemies: Confront threats, both human and inhuman, through combat, evasion, or strategy, wielding weapons and supernatural abilities.

  • Immersive Conversations: Pick dialogue choices with the potential to change the outcome of a task or alter your reputation with a particular faction. Your words have power so choose them wisely.

  • Dark Heritage: Choose one of the eight Legacies, derived from British folklore and history, from the seductive but ill-fated Baohan to the tormented Scottish nobles of the Camian.

  • The Powers That Be: Join one of the Estates of the Enigmata, the alliance that governs undead society; the faithful Disciples of the Bone Shepherd, the callous Kerrogan Collective, the mystical Fettered Way or the deceptive Whispering Monolith.

  • Become an Outsider: Alternatively, defect and become an outsider, by joining one of the Peregrine Hordes; the refined but unstable Lumeia, or the radical Brotherhood of Stygian Wisdom.

A dark and twisted version of our world where supernatural creatures hide among humanity. Vampires, magical folk, and other beings compete for power and influence through secret societies, corporate power, and religious sects.

Harrowed World takes creatures of myth and folklore reimagining them as concealed predators and tricksters. This vision of the world is dystopian and bleak with both human and inhuman horrors, but most people are blissfully ignorant of the dark forces at work around them.

Harrowed World is the shared setting and franchise of a growing number of video games and (soon) books, combing elements of gothic horror, adventure, dystopian fiction, drama, science fiction, Lovecraftian horror, and urban fantasy. Experience Harrowed World from a variety of perspectives from the prowling vampire to the monster hunting Beholder.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game revolves around vampires in a horror setting and will contain many depictions or references to many amoral, sensitive, disturbing, and monstrous things, such as drinking blood, murder, manipulation, exploitation, suicide, abuse, and religion. This is not an excuse to be a monster yourself.

This game is not suitable for those who are easily offended or upset by such content.

detailed_description:
WANT MORE VAMPIRE GAMES?

Harrowed World is the shared setting and franchise of a growing number of video games and (soon) books.

Check out our FREE gothic vampire visual novel, that acts a precursor to this very game. Find 'Harrowed World: What's Past Is Portents' and other Harrowed World games using the 'Check out the entire Harrowed World collection on Steam' link above.

Step into a dark and unforgiving world where vampires pull the strings of humanity. You are not the hero, you are not the villain, you are nothing but a pawn in schemes that you cannot even begin to understand. Some things are better left secret, kept hidden away from prying eyes.
